summary: Replay supplied or synthetic route and object-inspection events with provenance and missing-data states, without fabricating visitors or inferring causal behavior.
objective: Build a privacy-bounded evaluation view where I inspect ordered visits, dwell intervals and interaction outcomes for one declared dataset revision.
example_prompts: Replay a synthetic museum route dataset and compare exhibit dwell counts while labeling missing consent and unknown intervals.
negative_signals: Not live surveillance, identity inference, emotion detection, causal UX proof or a universal museum metric.
not_for: No face/device fingerprinting, fabricated observed visitors, cross-dataset identity join or unlabeled synthetic records.

entities.name: Evaluation dataset
entities.guidance: Accept supplied consented or explicitly synthetic records only; store dataset revision, collection purpose, consent/permission label, time origin, clock domain and missingness policy.

entities.name: Route and exhibit view
entities.guidance: Map event exhibit IDs to the accessible museum scene, but preserve unmapped/unknown IDs in a ledger instead of inventing positions.

state_contract.model: An immutable dataset revision contains pseudonymous session IDs only when supplied and authorized, ordered events (enter/leave/select/inspect/complete/error), timestamps in one declared clock domain, exhibit IDs and optional accessibility/input mode fields. Synthetic sessions carry an explicit synthetic=true label. Reject missing permission according to project policy; never convert it to observed data. Stable-sort equal timestamps by original sequence. Dwell intervals require a matched enter/leave policy and otherwise remain unknown. Aggregates expose denominator, missingness and filter revision; comparisons are descriptive and never causal. Reset clears filters, playback cursor and selection, not source data.
state_contract.authority: Three.js owns the versioned semantic state, model time, history and reset; Blender/glTF assets are named presentation resources only.
actions: Load an authorized supplied or labeled synthetic dataset.
Replay one session or inspect an aggregate with denominator.
Filter by declared fields without exposing identity.
Reset cursor/filters and export only policy-approved aggregate data.

invariants: Every displayed path/event maps to an exact source record or is visibly unknown.
Synthetic and supplied observations never merge without labels.
Missing consent/permission never becomes an inferred approval.
Dwell and completion aggregates retain unknown/missing cases and make no causal claim.
motion_guidance: Drive presentation from a seekable model time and derive every visible transform from current state; pause and scrub never advance hidden semantic state.
Provide a static sequence/list and reduced-motion mode that preserves text, order, choices and status.
creative_affordances: Choose typography, assets, palette, staging and metaphor per the supplied brief and licensed material; no house style is mandatory.
Blender owns expressive geometry, rigs, sets and cue anchors; Three.js owns time, branch/state, captions, interruption and checkpoints.
known_limits: Project policy and dataset fields must be reviewed for the actual study; this profile supplies no legal determination, consent form, anonymity guarantee or statistical inference.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no Blender export, audio playback, visitor study, show-control link, browser or renderer was run.

claims.statement: High Resolution Time defines a monotonic time value relative to a time origin and explains that time origins can differ between contexts; timestamps therefore need an explicit origin/domain before comparison.
claims.scope: Web performance time coordinates; event meaning, consent and study interpretation remain authored dataset policy.

source_refs.locator: Time concepts, monotonic clock, time origin and translating timestamps between globals

object_craft.structure: Use subdued anonymous path ribbons, exhibit ID pylons and a synchronized event table; unknown locations remain in an unplaced lane.
object_craft.material: Patterns distinguish synthetic, supplied and missing states; density color never implies satisfaction or causation.

physical_contract.scope: Spatial layout and motion communicate authored media/state; geometry and collisions have no physical authority.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate from seekable authored time or discrete event state; no physics integration.
checks: presentation controls leave semantic data unchanged
